TikTok is a global technology company focused on inspiring creativity and bringing joy through short-form mobile video. The Frontend Software Engineer will develop and maintain an enterprise-grade CRM platform, collaborating with global product and engineering teams to build sales, marketing, and analytics tools. The role also involves addressing user requirements, operating SaaS CRM systems, and delivering efficient frontend solutions.

- Familiarity with React, Angular, Vue, or any popular frontend framework
- Experience in solving CSS/JS multi-browser compatibility problems and front-end performance optimization
- Good design and coding taste, excellent coding ability - including speed and overall quality
- Knowledge of standard CRM functionality across the Lead to Compensation pipeline
- Knowledge or familiarity with Ad Sales automated processes and best practices in a CRM platform
